scripts.dev:apps: bun run --filter ./server dev & bun run --filter ./client dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter ./client build && bun run --filter ./server build
scripts.build:widget: cd widget && bun install && bun run build
scripts.check: biome check server/src client/src e2e playwright.config.ts playwright.a11y.config.ts && bun run check:design-system
scripts.test:e2e:ci: bun run --filter ./client build && CI=true bunx playwright test
